verdict.rationale: The docs describe an official Unstructured Python SDK that can partition, enrich, chunk, and embed files and manage workflows. The Python quickstart also covers structured-field extraction, and job APIs exist for triggering runs and monitoring status. The evidence only ever mentions Python and REST/cURL clients, though, so there is no TypeScript SDK, and the story asks for both. Missing for 10: an official TypeScript SDK, evidence that the SDKs are typed, explicit SDK coverage of the jobs API, documentation of sensible defaults, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
